description_en: Queries watch duration data by live stream ID, including standard-latency watch duration and low-latency watch duration
description_zh: 调用DescribeMeterImpWatchLiveTimeByLiveId查看观看时长相关数据，包含普通延迟观看时长，低延迟观看时长
name: DescribeMeterImpWatchLiveTimeByLiveId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live stream resource. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically generates a 36-character random UUID string
parameters.help_zh: 直播资源的唯一标识ID，传空值时，系统自动生成36位随机UUID字符串
parameters.name: live_id

Data.description_zh: 查询观看时长返回结果

WatchTimeInLatency.description_en: The standard-latency watch duration, such as watching over RTMP, FLV, or HLS protocols. Unit: minutes
WatchTimeInLatency.description_zh: 普通延迟观看时长，如采用rtmp、flv、hls等协议观看，单位分钟

WatchTimeInLowLatency.description_en: The low-latency watch duration, such as watching over RTS. Unit: minutes
WatchTimeInLowLatency.description_zh: 低延迟观看时长，如rts，单位分钟
